title: Job Offer Letter
description: Letter offering a candidate a position with salary and start date.

fields.name: reply_by
fields.label: Date to accept the offer by

body: We are pleased to offer you the position of {job_title} at {company_name}, starting on {start_date}.
Your monthly salary will be {monthly_salary}. You will report to {manager_name}.
Please confirm your acceptance by {reply_by} by replying to {hr_contact_email}.
We look forward to working with you.
